import itertools
from pysat.solvers import Glucose3
edges = list(itertools.combinations(range(8), 2))
num_edges = len(edges)
edge_to_var = {e: i+1 for i, e in enumerate(edges)}
solver = Glucose3()
for four in itertools.combinations(range(8), 4):
    k4_edges = list(itertools.combinations(four, 2))
    vars_list = [edge_to_var[tuple(sorted((a,b)))] for a,b in k4_edges]
    solver.add_clause(vars_list)  # at least one true (blue)
    solver.add_clause([-v for v in vars_list])  # at least one false (red)
if solver.solve():
    model = solver.get_model()
    colors = [1 if x > 0 else 0 for x in model]
    print(colors)
    print(len(colors))
else:
    print("UNSATISFIABLE")
